subject: Regarding DiscoverEdges.py script to get xml files for Advanced TI calculation analysis:

messages.author: Kankana Bhattacharjee
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I have obtained dvdl.dat and efep.dat files for the ACES tutorial for com
and aq systems for single trial run. After that, I have made results folder
under rbfe. Then used python DiscoverEdges.py script to get xml file. But,
for my case only one xml file is generated i.e, 1h1q~1h1r.xml after
processing the DiscoverEdges script. Now, kindly help me how to proceed
with this xml file to obtain the final output i.e, relative binding free
energy ?
Here, I am attaching my DiscoverEdges.py script and 1h1q~1h1r.xml file.
Your suggestion is highly appreciated.
Thanks and regards
Kankana Bhattacharjee
Ph.D. Scholar
Department of Chemistry
Ashoka University
Sonipat, Haryana

messages.author: Kankana Bhattacharjee
messages.body:
Ok. Thanks a lot.
On Tue, Sep 10, 2024 at 8:12 PM Timothy Giese <giese025.rutgers.
edu> wrote:
> The ACES tutorial needs to be updated. It refers to tools that are no
> longer used. You are correct that you should use edgembar rather than
> graphmbar. Once you have the edgembar input xml file, you should run the
> edgembar program. The edgembar output will be written to a file, which
> happens to be a python script. Running that python script without any
> options will create an HTML report containing the free energy and
> convergence information for all trials, stages, and environments. If you
> have multiple edges, then independently run edgembar on each edge. You can
> perform a networkwide analysis and write a HTML graph report using
> edgembar-WriteGraphHtml.py (the edge outputs are the inputs to this
> script). There is online documentation for edgembar here:
>
https://rutgerslbsr.gitlab.io/fe-toolkit/edgembar/index.html
.
> Specifically, refer to the section labeled "General Workflow" which gives a
> quick overview of the procedure. The documentation also walks through an
> example using some toy data. The data is included with the source code at
>
https://gitlab.com/RutgersLBSR/fe-toolkit
. One can also directly download
> the data here:
>
https://gitlab.com/RutgersLBSR/fe-toolkit/-/blob/master/public/edgembar/data.tar.gz?ref_type=heads
>
>
